---
name: Security report
about: 'DO NOT use this template for a real vulnerability report — see instructions below'
title: "[Do not file a public issue for a security report]"
labels: security
---

**Stop — do not describe a suspected vulnerability in this public issue.**

Per [`GOVERNANCE.md` §11](../../docs/GOVERNANCE.md#11-security-governance),
a security issue in the language, compiler, runtime, or standard library
**MUST be reported privately**, not through this public issue tracker, so
a fix can be prepared before the issue becomes public knowledge.

Please report it using the private channel described in
[`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md) instead.

This template exists only to redirect reporters who land here first; it
intentionally collects no vulnerability details.
